repo_resolution_method: Repository root resolved as two levels above src/mve/data_loader.py; path joined relative to that root. No absolute user-machine path, no glob, no first-match.
volume_policy: real_volume is preferred only if it contains meaningful positive observations; it is all-zero here, so tick_volume is selected.
provenance_note: File committed in-repo under quant-lab/data (LFS-tracked). It is the primary file named in the repaired DATA_TRUTH_LOCK and is consumed by the repo's own DMR/rekey backtest engines, giving consistent provenance.
selection_rationale: Chosen over EURUSDPRO_M5_2023_2025.csv and EURUSD_M5.csv on objective criteria, not on MVE outcomes: (1) it is the primary asset named in the repaired truth lock and R0 inventory; (2) richest explicit schema (epoch `time` plus human `timestamp`, `tick_volume`, `spread`, `real_volume`); (3) longest *_2023_2026 coverage (2023-07-03 to 2026-05-29); (4) epoch `time` enables unambiguous deterministic timestamp parsing. EURUSD_M5.csv has longer history (2022 start) but a sparser schema (string timestamp only, single `volume` field) and no spread/tick volume distinction.
